state:
**Side goal `test-scratch-and-hover`, stage 2.** `nvs_repo::scratch(name) -> Scratch` (`crates/nvs-repo/src/lib.rs`) is a fresh directory `target/test-scratch/<name>-<pid>-<n>`, deleted when the guard drops. `nvs_repo::scratch_private(name)` is `case/` inside one such directory locked to this account (Unix `0700` on both; Windows one `icacls /inheritance:r /grant:r *S-1-3-4:(OI)(CI)F`, which `case/` inherits), for a test that runs the ownership check. `a_private_scratch_dir_is_inside_the_boundary` in `crates/nvs-config/tests/trust.rs` pins it against `nvs_config::trust::check`.

The guard `no_test_code_writes_into_the_system_temp_dir` is in `crates/nvs-repo/tests/scratch.rs`, with `SUBJECT` (empty) and the `NOT_YET_MOVED` ratchet, which fails when a file's count moves either way. Moving a site means lowering or deleting its row in the same commit.

**All 25 `nvs-cli` calls are moved** (70 calls left in other crates). `cache.rs`, `config.rs` and `tests/init.rs` use `scratch_private`. The pattern: a helper that returned a `PathBuf` now returns the `Scratch`, and the test binds it for as long as it reads the files. A `Scratch` is not `Into<PathBuf>`: pass `dir.path()`.

`target/test-scratch/init-cmd-windows-steps-*` on this machine are leftovers from an earlier session's reverted attempt, not from a current test. `cargo clean` removes them. Stage 3 (hover) is not started.

**`bun nv verify`'s `extension` step fails in this worktree** because `editors/vscode/node_modules` does not exist (`Cannot find name 'node:fs'`, `Cannot find module 'vscode'`). Every Rust step was green. An `npm ci` in `editors/vscode` is the call this session did not make; it needs the user's go-ahead.

items.text: **Move the `nvs-lsp` sites (18 rows)**, the same way. Many only build a URI with `uri_of(&std::env::temp_dir().join(..))` and never write the file: give those a path under one `Scratch` the test holds. A site whose subject is the system temp directory goes to `SUBJECT` with its reason — `crates/nvs-lsp/src/definition.rs:1597`, `crates/nvs-lsp/src/document.rs:808`, `crates/nvs-lsp/tests/navigation.rs:230`
**Move `nvs-config`'s two rows** (`tests/trust.rs`, `tests/control.rs`) onto `scratch_private`, since both run the ownership check — `crates/nvs-config/tests/trust.rs:22`

backlog: Move the rest (`nvs-stdlib`, `nvs-runtime`, `nvs-test`, `nvs-host`, `nvs-db`, `nvs-server`, `nvs-types`, `nvs-hir`, `nvs-footprint`): `crates/nvs-repo/tests/scratch.rs`. One that runs the ownership check uses `scratch_private`.
Stage 3: hover on a `use` line, an `implements` clause and type positions; references list `use` lines and the lens does not count them (`docs/agent/goals/side/test-scratch-and-hover.md`).
`crates/nvs-cli/src/service.rs` and `crates/nvs-cli/src/tmp.rs` still end tests with an explicit `remove_dir_all(&root)`. That is harmless because the guard's drop ignores a missing directory.
